primary_question: Does present-day capitulum integration persist as detectable shared evolutionary history after phylogenetic, reconstruction and topology uncertainty are propagated?
primary_answer_locked_before_reframe: The observed continuous branch-change coupling is descriptive and does not exceed the reconstruction-aware null; the coordinated-remodeling headline is prohibited.
retained_evidence: within-taxon registered-module contrast exceeds the among-taxon contrast at both frozen observation thresholds
orientation, phyllary posture and stickiness require repeated minimum changes
recurrence-count robustness differs from exact transition-placement identifiability
discrete transition overlap and module-specific continuous coupling are not topology-robust
the source-balanced Japan7 lightness analysis does not replicate the earlier global anti-phylogenetic direction

jpn29_provenance_correction.reason: The JPN_29 nuclear voucher taxon identity is unresolved and the existing gate prohibits a clean trait-to-tip join.
jpn29_provenance_correction.outcome_rule: Report the result in either direction. A favourable result cannot reinstate the coordinated-remodeling headline or replace the frozen eight-concept FAIL.
jpn29_provenance_correction.not_evaluable_rule: If exclusion leaves fewer than six concepts for a unit or common panel, retain not_evaluable and do not substitute another taxon, endpoint or threshold.

jeb_framing.headline: Phenotypic integration is scale dependent and does not automatically predict shared evolutionary history.
jeb_framing.general_insight: Present-day integration, recurrence counts, exact transition placement and shared branch localization are distinct evolutionary estimands.
jeb_framing.negative_result_boundary: Absence of robust signal is not evidence of evolutionary independence, zero lability or absence of biological integration.

prohibited_repairs: change the eight continuous endpoints after inspecting the null
promote topology-positive branch correlations without the reconstruction-aware null
use JPN_29 to represent a clean Japanese phenotype tip before specimen-level identity resolution
call minimum steps independent origins, convergence or adaptation
call substitution-scaled branches absolute time or rate per million years
